test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2faacbc6088fb7fdcd0e211727552077d67c8887727c923c8b8e034683cdf7ea.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first two elements of first row interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cd39b9301185e32c4eb35ed0e29838903c6cb9632ee864d5645ea56028c999a.png] 

2) Second box series →

The last two elements of first row interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37a3f87469d126856d03a8096bcec9783795fb77b128cc6eef00a0e2f498651d.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90722654322f4554bf7b366279b2af86250c8034b50b387bf271ec4cfc8c3d31.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
